The Panther Eagle Mine in the Whitesville area of Raleigh County has had just shy of 1,100 safety and health violations assessed to its operator, Marfork Coal Company LLC, by MSHA since the start of 2019, according to agency records. The Ohio County Mine in the Dallas area of Marshall County, controlled by St. Clairsville, Ohio-based American Consolidated Natural Resources, has had more than 1,800 penalties assessed to operator Ohio County Coal Resources, Inc. by MSHA since the start of 2019, according to agency records. String of Panther Eagle Mine safety violations Of the nearly 1,100 violations assessed by MSHA to Marfork for the Panther Eagle Mine, 139 were deemed “Significant and Substantial” by MSHA.
